recovered_positive_knowledge: Input First demonstrates that typed text is a first-class Prometeo human-input affordance, but its catalog status is RECOVERED SOURCE_REFERENCE and it is not Capture authority.

The retired V2 donor had a useful combined Capture/Inbox grammar: microphone entry, pause/save/discard, consecutive local recording, page/all filtering, editable transcripts, local audio playback, clipboard copy and Patent preparation.

The V1 VoiceQueue donor established retained-stream consecutive recording, local-first audio durability and non-blocking background transcription; those behaviors are already represented by the current P4 RecorderController/TranscriptionQueue.
The current P4 architecture explicitly requires mining useful V2 Capture/Inbox behavior without keeping V2 as Navigator-global chrome.

negative_knowledge: Do not restore V2/V3 competing global injectors or infer that their files are active owners.
Do not add page-local microphones or page-local text Capture stores when shared/capture/v1 already owns human intent.
Do not treat the Input First page, an old shell, or a recovered source reference as Current/Human Accepted/Served authority.
Do not auto-confirm typed human text merely because it was entered directly; it starts EDITED and explicit confirmation remains distinct.
Do not treat Play or Copy as PROJECT export; neither may bypass the explicit export receipt boundary.
Do not fabricate physical microphone evidence, Android evidence, live human export approval or Human Acceptance.
Do not infer that a green or publicly reachable isolated canary is the served production owner.
